transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
German Chancellor urges businesses to embrace artificial intelligence as Nvidia announces new investments. Reported by CNBC: open your doors for artificial intelligence.
Domestic artificial intelligence surges strongly following DeepSeek new version release and technology-driven commerce policy benefits. Reported by 搜狐: the Sci-Tech Innovation Artificial Intelligence ETF Huabao tracking index surges 3.4 percent.
Reported by Canadian HR Reporter: OpenAI trades lawsuit puts spotlight on competitor hiring practices and workforce strategies.
China proposes artificial intelligence export controls on chip design and computing clusters. Reported by digitimes: the controls reach beyond chips to design intellectual property and computing infrastructure.
Anthropic's latest report shows artificial intelligence agents now work 6 times longer than humans. Reported by 投资界: this shift reduces junior roles and reshapes the future workplace toward managing artificial intelligence systems.
Free every hour.
